name: n8n-code-javascript
description: Write JavaScript in n8n Code nodes; use `$input`/`$json`/`$node`, `$helpers`, DateTime, and troubleshoot or choose modes.

Choose **Run Once for All Items** for most use cases: runs once; use `$input.all()` for aggregation, filtering, batch processing, transformations, or API calls. Choose **Run Once for Each Item** for independent per-item logic; use `$input.item`. Need multiple items? Use All Items. Items independent? Use Each Item. Unsure? Use All Items.

Access data with `$input.all()`, `$input.first()`, `$input.item`, or `$node["Node Name"].json`. **CRITICAL: Must return `[{json: {...}}]` format**. **CRITICAL: Webhook data is under `$json.body` (not `$json` directly)**. **CRITICAL RULE: Always return array of objects with `json` property**. Return `items.map(item => ({json: item.json}))`; never return raw items, a plain object, or data lacking the `json` wrapper. Return an empty array when there is no data to return.

Use JavaScript directly (no `{{ }}`); use template literals such as `` `${$json.field}` ``. Use optional chaining/guards for missing fields. Prefer filter/map/reduce; filter before expensive transformations. Use clear variable names. Debug with `console.log()`.

Built-ins: `$helpers.httpRequest()`, `DateTime` (Luxon), `$jmespath()`.
HTTP: `await $helpers.httpRequest({url: 'https://api.example.com/data'})`.
Dates: `DateTime.now()`, `.toFormat('yyyy-MM-dd')`, `.toISO()`, `.plus({days: 1})`, `.minus({weeks: 1})`.
JMESPath: `$jmespath(data, 'users[*].name')`.

Use Code for complex transformations, calculations, parsing, conditionals, and aggregation. Prefer Set for simple mapping, Filter for filtering, IF/Switch for simple conditionals, and HTTP Request for HTTP-only tasks.

Before deploying Code nodes, verify:
[ ] **Code is not empty** - Must have meaningful logic
[ ] **Return statement exists** - Must return array of objects
[ ] **Proper return format** - Each item: `{json: {...}}`
[ ] **Data access correct** - Using `$input.all()`, `$input.first()`, or `$input.item`
[ ] **No n8n expressions** - Use JavaScript template literals: `` `${value}` ``
[ ] **Error handling** - Guard clauses for null/undefined inputs
[ ] **Webhook data** - Access via `.body` if from webhook
[ ] **Mode selection** - "All Items" for most cases
[ ] **Performance** - Prefer map/filter over manual loops
[ ] **Output consistent** - All code paths return same structure

n8n MCP tools:
- Find Code node: `search_nodes({query: "code"})`
- Configuration: `get_node_essentials("nodes-base.code")`
- Validate: `validate_node_operation()`
